title: Lantern Court
shortDescription: Blue lanterns drift beneath the welcoming arms of an ancient oak.
longDescription:
Ancient oak branches arch over a circular courtyard paved with warm, uneven stones. Blue lanterns drift between the leaves like stars that have come down to listen.
Porter Bramble keeps a cheerful watch beside a noticeboard crowded with curling paper. Footpaths lead toward the hall, the orchard, the cloister, and the gate; somewhere below their roots, a low note seems to answer the wind.

fixtures.name: Porter Bramble
fixtures.lookDescription: A hedgehog porter in a too-large coat, brass whistle on a ribbon, Small Copper Key in his paw.
fixtures.examineDescription: Porter Bramble is a hedgehog in a too-large porter's coat, quills neatly combed, a brass whistle bouncing on a ribbon. He holds a Small Copper Key for new Collegians. Type take Small Copper Key — all three words — if Arrival is still your task.
fixtures.dialogue: "This is a school. We train woodland students to face real dangers in the Greenwood. Typed commands are how you learn. Type look, say hello, take Small Copper Key, then north to reach the Great Hall. Type talk porter and answer with say 1 or say 2 if you want more."

school.text: "The Collegium is a school. Woodland students learn here to face real dangers in the Greenwood. This is where the animals are trained. Typed commands are how you learn."

commands.text: "Type look to see Lantern Court. Type say hello. Type take Small Copper Key — all three words. Then type north to reach the Great Hall."

greenwood.text: "Outside these lanterns the wood is not a storybook. Students train here first, so they are not surprised later."

ready.text: "Good. Stay with me through Arrival. Type take Small Copper Key if you have not, then type north to reach the Great Hall."

fixtures.name: Noticeboard
fixtures.examineDescription:
NEED A FIRST ADVENTURE? Talk to Porter for directions. Librarian Quill seeks careful readers in the Library Stacks, west of the Great Hall. Groundskeeper Tansy needs observant helpers in the Herb Garden, west of the South Orchard. Headmaster Alder is listening for an impossible bell in the Great Hall.
Try talk porter. Examine named objects with examine or x. Type quests for your checklist.
